name: dumbbell wood chop squat
description: Squat down and swing a dumbbell diagonally across your body. It trains legs, trunk rotation and shoulders in one movement.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands by one hip.
Stand up and swing the dumbbell diagonally across to overhead on the other side.
Rotate your torso and pivot your back foot as you go.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.
